concerns.text: FR-001 requires curating a dataset of logic/arithmetic puzzles. Task T013 is marked [ ] (pending) and relies on T000a (schema) which is also [ ]. While T011 (generator) is [X], the specific task to 'Curate an initial dataset... by running generator.py' and validate it against the schema is not marked complete, leaving the core data artifact for US-1 unverified in the task list.

Constitution Principle III mandates 'Datasets MUST be checksummed'. Task T014 ('Add checksum validation for all files in data/raw/') is marked [ ] (pending). Without this task being marked complete or integrated into T013, the project lacks a defined task to satisfy the non-negotiable data integrity requirement.

SC-001 requires the statistical framework (equivalence vs. non-inferiority) to be pre-registered and measured. Task T028 ('Implement TOST... for equivalence testing') is marked [ ] (pending). While T028a handles pre-registration, the actual implementation of the TOST logic required to measure the 'equivalence' outcome is missing from the completed tasks.

SC-005 requires measuring scalability by characterizing the computational complexity class (Big-O). Task T029 ('Implement scalability analysis... to derive the formal complexity class') is marked [ ] (pending). The task to perform the log-log linear regression and output the complexity class is not complete.

FR-004 requires recording success rates for both symbolic-guided and neural-verifier baseline variants. Tasks T030a (Symbolic BES loop entry point) and T030b (Neural Baseline BES loop entry point) are both marked [ ] (pending). The execution of the experiments required to generate the data for FR-004 is not covered by completed tasks.

FR-004 and SC-001/002 require generating a final report with success rates, costs, and statistical significance. Tasks T031a (report generation logic) and T031 (generate final report) are marked [ ] (pending). The task to produce the final scientific output is missing.

FR-001 and the plan require `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` and `contracts/output.schema.yaml` to define data structures. Tasks T000a and T000b (Generate schemas) are marked [ ] (pending). The foundational design artifacts required for T013 and T016 are not marked as complete.

The plan defines a strict directory structure (`data/raw`, `data/processed`, etc.) as a prerequisite for data hygiene. Tasks T001a (Create project directory structure) and T004 (Setup data directory structure) are marked [ ] (pending). The physical environment required to store data and code is not established in the task list.

The plan mandates `pytest` and linting (flake8/black) as part of the testing and code quality strategy. Task T003 ('Configure linting') is marked [ ] (pending). The automated quality gates required to ensure reproducibility are not defined as complete.

The plan requires a `README.md` detailing how to run the BES loop. Task T032 ('Documentation updates in README.md') is marked [ ] (pending). The documentation required for reproducibility (Constitution Principle I) is not complete.
The plan requires the pipeline to execute within the CI time limit. Task T036 ('Run quickstart.md validation') is marked [ ] (pending). The validation of the execution constraints is not complete.

Task T017a and T017b are marked [X] (complete) but the text includes 'Split from T017 to address atomization' and 'Note: Split from T017'. This suggests T017 was a prior task that no longer exists or was replaced. If T017 does not exist in the current spec/plan, these tags are stale references to a non-existent parent task ID.
